title: Smart Routing now supports external models for coding agents (Beta)
body: In the Unity Gateway Managed Configuration beta, Smart Routing can route coding-agent subagents to external models behind a model provider service. Add them to `models.sources`, alongside `system.ai` models if needed. See [Choose model sources for each agent](/aws/en/ai-gateway/coding-agent-configure-govern#choose-model-sources-for-each-agent).

ref_links.text: Choose model sources for each agent
